name: HStack
description: Flex container that arranges its children horizontally in a row. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: inline
props.description: Displays the container as `inline-flex` instead of `flex`, so it sits inline with surrounding content.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the order of the children, setting `flex-direction` to `row-reverse`.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: HStack.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
